# AKS Creative Studio

> Projection mapping and immersive media studio founded in 2019 by projection
> mapping artist Fahad Khan Tareen. Based in Islamabad, Pakistan. Works on
> national monuments, heritage buildings, event stages, and hotel and mall
> facades in Pakistan and internationally.

## What we do

Large Format Spectacle:
- Architectural projection mapping
- Immersive installations
- Live event visuals
- LED facades
- VR / AR
- HoloFans and mesh

Freelance Content:
- 2D and 3D motion graphics
- Brand films and promos
- Short-form social
- Title sequences and loops
- Sound design
- AI-assisted production

## Recognition
- 2nd Place, 5th Festival of Lights, World Championship of Projection Mapping, TV Tower, Berlin, 2019
- BBBank Newcomer, Schlosslichtspiele Karlsruhe, 2021

## Selected work
- Marka-e-Haq Monument (2026), monument mapping
- ICC Launch Event (2025), Pakistan Monument
- Mohatta Palace (2024), BankIslami, Karachi
- Parliament House, Islamabad
- Minar-e-Pakistan, Graana.com launch, Lahore
- Heritage and forts: Rohtas, Noor Mahal, Islamia College
- Events and venues: Future Fest, Centaurus, Bahria Town

## How we work
1. Connect: scope, timeline, budget and site.
2. Concept: mood, approach and the effect on the audience.
3. Create: build it and stay on site until it runs as drawn.

## Where we work
Based in Islamabad, Pakistan. Projects across Pakistan and internationally,
remote or on the ground.
